findings: subsystems.json has ONE magic path only: combat.magic.casting (souls, 10-combat, critic.combat). New root magic.* must be requested in reply; taxonomy is append-only, owned by CRT.

RI-PRG02 already fixes the caster stats: WILLPOWER = max Focus (FP) + spell-slot count (slots at WIL 15/25/35/50) + status resist; INTELLECT = Sorcery scaling; HIST-BOND = Root/restoration + Hist-invocation scaling. So the resource is ALREADY named Focus/FP in the corpus -> RI-MAG01 must rule FP, not stamina, and reconcile.

RI-PRG03 fixes 4 magic skills: Sorcery(INT), Root-Speech(HIST-BOND), Warding(WIL), Veiling(WIL). Spell tiers req 0/25/45/65/85; below req a spell CANNOT BE EQUIPPED (not 'fails'). Focus cost -0.5%/skill pt above req, floored -35%. Cast that produced a measurable effect = 12 skill points; 450 casts -> skill 79.
RI-PRG03 Cost Gate: casting at a wall with no target grants ZERO progress. Focus is listed as a thing 'the world can run out of'.
Attribute soft caps: WIL soft 30 hard 50, INT soft 40 hard 60, HIST-BOND soft 40 hard 60. scalingBonus table in PRG02 §4 is reusable for spell scaling.
HEARTH = the bonfire analogue (RI-PRG04). S7: HEARTH shrines are NOT part of the travel network.

RI-LOR05 §3 already rules soul gems: 'xul-hesh' = root-theft, Molag Bal-patron, reads locally as poisoning a well/kidnapping. Soul-gem trade is main-quest crisis CAUSE A (real aggravation, not the true cause; C is authorially true). This is the settled ground for the S15/soul-gem ruling: gems intercept the Rootward Tide; they are NOT sap-debt and cannot be spent as souls.
RI-LOR05 §7 rule 1: souls never buy an item, bribe, repair, fare or training. Rule 4: sap-taint never alters frames/hitboxes/telegraphs/damage/AI.
RI-PRG05 prices: Tier-1 spell 220g, Tier-2 900g, Tier-3 3400g. Only 3 tiers priced though PRG03 defines 5 (req 0/25/45/65/85). Tier 4/5 prices are a GAP I must fill or flag.
RI-PRG05 four un-buyables + flip invariant max(sell)=0.60 < min(buy)=0.80. Any magic that mints gold or items breaks it -> Fortify-Mercantile / enchanted-item-selling loops must be checked.

RI-CMB03: base regen 45/s = 0.75/frame flat, does NOT scale with any stat; regen delay 42 frames (0.700s) re-armed by every spend. Roll cost 22/26/34/40. Walk/turn/camera free. Stamina zero without block = inputs dropped, no stagger.

RI-AI02 telegraph law: hard floor W >= 12 frames for EVERY attack incl. ranged (S6 ranged projectile min W 24f, Tc <= 0.70W with aim lock at Tc). AP6 bans teleport/blink >1.2m in one frame. This binds enemy casters directly.

BAR-CRITIQUE-01 G4 thresholds (binding target): >=40 effects; >=12 effects with an out-of-fight use that changes traversal or quest resolution; hard fail if every effect is damage/heal or if spellmaking absent. Enchant materials never purchasable, never respawn-farmable.
BAR-CRITIQUE-01 G2/AR-3 threshold for RI-CMP01: >=35% of system pairs non-none, >=8 fight-boundary-crossing cells, hard fail below 4. RI-MAG04 is a direct contributor.

RI-EXP06 (permissiveness budget) does not exist yet; the experience agent owns it. Its rule: >=12 sanctioned breakages, >=4 systemic, >=2 producing permanent unrecoverable world state; no new anti-exploit hard fail without naming the register entry it leaves open.

RULING (MAG01, written): resource is Focus AND stamina. Focus = ammunition (WILLPOWER pool 30@WIL10 -> 94@WIL30 soft -> 112@WIL50 -> 124@99), spent frame 1, NEVER regenerates (only HEARTH rest + respawn). Stamina = tempo, flat per class, re-arms CMB03's 42-frame regen delay. Stamina-only rejected (sterile, strands WILLPOWER, kills PRG03 Cost Gate); Focus-only rejected (AR-1: cast+roll in same window).

MAG01 cast classes ES-CAST/1: CANTRIP 14/3/20=37 stam10 Fx0.50; LIGHT 24/4/28=56 stam16 Fx1.00; HEAVY 36/6/40=82 stam24 Fx2.10 HA f22-42; GREAT 52/8/60=120 stam34 Fx4.40 HA f32-60; RITUAL 150/12/48=210. Ps={15,25,37,53}. Tc=ceil(0.65*startup). Recovery commit constant 0.60 (weapons use 0.45).

RITUAL class is the S19 enforcement device: Mark/Recall/Intervention are RITUAL, 150f startup, abort on damage/COMBAT/movement input with Focus REFUNDED (only refund case). No 'cannot cast in combat' flag needed - the clock does it.
Casting input = light/heavy with catalyst in right hand (Souls mapping, no new button). ONE new button requested: spell_cycle. Attuning is HEARTH-only.
Enchanted items have their OWN charge pool recharged from soul gems -> that is the caster's sustain, which is why enchanting is load-bearing not optional.
effects.json SHIPPED: 55 effects (sorcery 14, root_speech 14, warding 15, veiling 12). 40 change traversal-or-quest (bar was >=12). 8/55 = 14.5% pure damage/heal. All G4 thresholds cleared.

COST FORMULA (final, binding): focus_base = ceil( weight * ( M^1.30 + 0.7*D^0.95 + 0.55*M^0.80*D^0.45 ) * (1 + 0.09*A^1.25) * range_mult / 10 ). focus_cost = ceil(focus_base * class_mult * catalyst_mult * (1-skill_discount)). Cross term kills the 1-second-nuke: nuke/balanced = 2.9x.
GOLD: round(3.9 * focus_base^1.75), FITTED to RI-PRG05's 220/900/3400 at focus_base 10/22/48 (residuals <3%). Tier4 ~8350g, Tier5 ~22200g -> PRG05 amendment requested.

LEVITATION RULING: ships, tier 4 (Warding 65), weight 9.0. Four bounds: (1) drift 1.4 m/s < 2.0 walk speed so never a time-saver; (2) ascent costs +1.5 Focus/metre and Focus never regenerates; (3) AIRBORNE = no attack/cast/block/roll/i-frames and ANY damage ends it; (4) diegetic ceilings - all 8 loop-dungeons enclosed, 65%+ exterior under collidable canopy 25-40m, above canopy = hackwing flock (WLD05 el.12). ZERO no_levitation_zone flags - grep asserts zero. Deleting it and fencing it both score 0.

TELEPORT RULING: mark/recall/intervention are RITUAL class (210f, aborts on damage/COMBAT/movement) so 'no recall out of a fight' needs no flag. recall magnitude is COMPUTED as distance/100m -> diegetic range limit (500m=6 focus, 4km=77 focus). intervention never goes to a HEARTH (S7). RI-TRV02 owns the network predicate/detector; MAG02 owns the effect records.
GREAT class max focus_base = 54 (at WIL99/staff/-35%), LIGHT max = 238. So the biggest spells must be cast in the class with NO hyperarmour. Emergent tension, worth citing.

SOUL GEM RULING SG-1..SG-6: (1) a gem never contains xul-teekh; sap-debt and gem-soul are different substances and different code quantities; trapping never changes your souls. (2) charge has exactly 2 sinks (enchant, recharge) -> not a currency. (3) FILLED gems have sell_value:null, unsellable by anyone ever; the smugglers who buy them are a QUEST not a merchant. (4) an enchantment adds full value on purchase, ZERO on sale -> no path from magic to gold, protects PRG05's flip invariant. (5) greater/grand souls hand-placed (22/12); a RESPAWNED creature yields a soul one grade LOWER (anti-farm); NPC souls untrappable except one main-quest artifact. (6) xul_hesh counter moves province-wide Argonian disposition, gates two faction lines opposite ways, never touches combat (AR-1).

ELEVEN SANCTIONED BREAKAGES MB-1..MB-11 written in RI-EXP06's register shape with a FAIL-test each. Systemic: MB-1,3,8,10. Permanent unrecoverable world state: MB-5, MB-11. Cross-rule accepted: no new anti-exploit hard fail in 25-magic without naming the MB it leaves open; table of hard-fails-added vs breakage-preserved is in MAG03 §D.

No Enchant skill added (would break PRG03 §3 budget + PRG02's 27-point figure). Enchanting gated by school skill (self ceiling = floor(0.9*skill)) and by WHO does it (4 journeymen/2 masters/1 recluse at 160 pts).
Enchant costs: on_use ceil(fb*2.5), on_strike ceil(fb*4.0), constant ceil(fb*18) and constant requires greater/grand soul. Charge per use = fb*4. Gold = round(6.5*points^1.35) x enchanter multiplier.
